pins.note: CURVED FLIGHT: the plaza rim opens south in a sector of steps (2 to 3 m) down to the sea stair. Traced as flat bands of 0.5 m; needs a curved flight (step 3).

thread.author: claude
thread.text: The rim's south opening is now 0.5 m bands joined by the new 'steps' edge, so it's walkable. A true curved flight still waits (kit-courtyard step 3) if the steps don't read right.

pins.note: STEP RINGS: the dais is two 0.5 m rings you can step up anywhere, and the plaza is sunk in two treads. The kit has no step between a 0.3 m kerb and a flight, so the dais and the sunk floor can't be reached (unreachable). Needs ring flights or a "steps" edge (step 3).
pins.author: claude

thread.author: claude
thread.text: New 'steps' edge in compile.py: a drop of 0.3 to 1 m with 'steps' on either side gets a run of steps (edge.steps.*, sweep.steps) and counts as a way through. The dais and the sunk floor are reachable. The pieces draw as outlines until the renderer learns them.

pins.note: SMALL STEPS: a 0.5 m stoop at each of the great hall's doors. Unreachable: same gap as the dais rings.
pins.author: claude

thread.author: claude
thread.text: Reachable by the same 'steps' rule (the stoops are a 'steps' level).

pins.note: SMALL STEPS: the overlook steps down two 0.4 m treads into its bay, with a 2.5 m drop on its prow (unguarded). Same gap; the bay's parapet comes back once the treads are steps.
pins.author: claude

thread.author: claude
thread.text: The treads join by 'steps'; over 1 m a 'steps' level falls back to a parapet, so the bay's 2.5 m prow is guarded.

pins.note: SCENE: the kit's flights are longer than plan D's (0.5 u per 0.15 m step), so the -2 m landing between the middle and lower sea stairs is too short. Fix: move the lower flight and the quay two cells toward the sea.
pins.author: claude

thread.author: claude
thread.text: Done (rev 1): the -2 m landing is now 4 rows, the lower flight's head is at row 64.5 and the quay runs out to row 74.

pins.note: CURVES: every arc in plan D (the three terraces, the round plaza, the balcony road) is a 45-degree stand-in. A curve object can only bulge from one straight edge; these need general curves (kit-courtyard step 2).
pins.author: claude

thread.author: claude
thread.text: New 'round' object in compile.py: every edge lying along a circle snaps onto the true arc, convex or concave. trace_plan.py emits one per circle plan D draws (25 kept). A tool for drawing them is asked of the Map Editor session.

pins.note: FLOORS: the sea and the stream are `water`, the quay and the bridge deck `deck`. They draw as paving until the editor's renderer learns both (asked of the Map Editor session).
pins.author: claude

thread.author: claude

thread.author: claude
thread.text: Fixed (rev 15 to 19). The plan's overlook stepped down in two treads 1 u deep, half a cell, so the trace made a sliver band plus a strip of balcony lip, and the steps had no room. Now the bay is one level ('the overlook bay', 5 m) with one run of steps up to the road; the sunk plaza is one level too (its 0.5 m ring merged), with one run of steps round it. And it is an error now: 'steps-runout' (compile.py) when a run of steps has no room for its treads below. It flags all 8 such places in the old scene.
